events.title: Welcome Back Colloquium
events.abstract: Find out what's in store for this semester, learn about CS student clubs, begin the election process for CoSSAC members, and get introduced to CS faculty and staff. Receive colloquium credit for attending.

events.speaker: Quanquan Liu
events.bio: Quanquan Liu is an Assistant Professor of Computer Science at Yale University. Her research focuses on the theory and practice of algorithms for large-scale data, including dynamic, distributed, and parallel graph algorithms, high-performance computing, differential privacy, and Byzantine-resilient algorithms. Before joining Yale, Liu was an Apple Research Fellow at the Simons Institute at UC Berkeley and held postdoctoral positions at Northwestern University and MIT. She received her Ph.D. in Computer Science from MIT, where she was advised by Erik Demaine and Julian Shun, as well as her B.S. in Computer Science and Mathematics and M.Eng. in Computer Science from MIT. Her research experience also includes work with Google's Discrete Algorithms Group and the MIT Digital Currency Initiative.
